# MilkDrink

[Index](../index.md) · [Rules](../rules.md) · [Sources](../sources.md)

An espresso drink with milk.

- Abstract: it has no members of its own, only its subclasses do.
- Is a: [EspressoDrink](c-espresso-drink.md)
- Subclasses: [Cappuccino](c-cappuccino.md), [Cortado](c-cortado.md), [FlatWhite](c-flat-white.md), [Latte](c-latte.md), [Macchiato](c-macchiato.md)
- Disjoint with: [PureEspresso](c-pure-espresso.md), [SweetenedDrink](c-sweetened-drink.md)

- **espressoToMilkRatio:** Parts espresso per part milk, so 1 means equal parts.
- **texture:** How the milk feels.
- **contains:** What goes into the drink.
- **origin:** Where the drink was first made.
- **pourOrder:** What goes in the cup first, and what goes on top.
- **pullVolumeMl:** Milliliters of espresso pulled for one drink.
- **variationOf:** A drink this one is a twist on.

## Rules

- [Milk drinks have milk](../rules.md#rule-milk-drinks-have-milk) (MUST): A MilkDrink MUST contain a milk ingredient. Source: [Vertex Coffee house guide > Milk drinks, line 5](../sources.md#loc-vertex-coffee-house-guide-bdsph9).
  > Every milk drink must contain milk or cream.
